description: Judicial and Security Services - Deaths and Injuries in Traffic Accidents by Month, Gender, and Role of Injured is a series of data sets listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. Detailed statistics on deaths and injuries in traffic accidents by month, gender, and location of the injured for the year 2022. Coverage: Qatar. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are traffic accidents, injuries, deaths, statistics. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
